method: Direct visual inspection of all 60 unmodified native Minecraft framebuffer PNGs using view_image.
scope_notes: Before images are upstream references identified in the before-view manifest; they do not claim to be exact historical AOE renders.
All seven before portal pairs intentionally show the upstream vanilla purple Nether portal and obsidian frame.
Crossed-plane plant geometry can look similar from views separated by 90 degrees.
After Nether portal views use pale wood on stone in the Desert staging area; other after portal views use oak-like wood on grass.
